# Autism Grown Up

> A neurodiversity-affirming organization providing accessible, easy-read and plain-language resources for autistic adults navigating life skills, employment, mental health, and lifespan transitions.

Autism Grown Up, Inc. is based in North Carolina and creates inclusive educational tools and advocacy resources designed specifically for autistic adults and neurodivergent communities, including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ individuals. The site emphasizes accessibility through easy-read formats and plain language across all content.

## Key Topics

- Autism support
- Life skills
- Autistic adults
- Easy read
- Plain language
- Lifespan resources
- Mental health toolkit
- Employment and careers
- Transition to adulthood
- Accessibility tools
- Advocacy toolkits
- BIPOC inclusion
- LGBTQIA+ affirming
- Neurodiversity
- Educational content
